children.name: xmlText
children.description: When true, this field receives its element's XML TEXT CONTENT during tolerant extract (JAXB @XmlValue / Jackson @JacksonXmlText / .NET [XmlText]) instead of a same-named child. No effect for @format: json.

children.name: example
children.description: FR-010: an example value for this field, shown in the generated output-format prompt fragment.

children.name: instruction
children.description: FR-010: a short instruction for this field, shown in the generated output-format prompt fragment.

children.name: enumAlias
children.description: Map of alternate/off-vocabulary tokens to canonical enum members; feeds the FR-010 tolerant extract alias-fold.

children.name: enumDoc
children.description: Map of enum member to a human-readable description; shown per-member in the FR-010 'guide'-style prompt fragment.

children.name: coerceDefault
children.description: Fallback enum member used by tolerant extract when a present value cannot be coerced; must be one of the field's @values.

children.name: normalize
children.description: ASCII normalization mode for tolerant enum extract (none|collapse|strip, default strip). On field.enum it is per-field; on object.value it is the default for the object's enum fields.

children.name: normalize
children.description: ASCII normalization mode for tolerant enum extract (none|collapse|strip, default strip). On field.enum it is per-field; on object.value it is the default for the object's enum fields.

children.name: promptStyle
children.description: FR-010 output-format prompt presentation: 'guide' (prose list + example), 'inline' (inline placeholders / enum choices), or 'exampleOnly' (filled skeleton). Guidance is never emitted as comments.

children.name: kind
children.description: Output shape: 'document' (renders @textRef in @format → one string) or 'email' (renders subject + html + optional text → a structured EmailDocument).

children.name: subjectRef
children.description: Email only: 2-layer logical reference (group/source) to the subject-line text. Required when @kind="email".

children.name: htmlBodyRef
children.description: Email only: 2-layer logical reference (group/source) to the HTML body text. Required when @kind="email".

children.name: textBodyRef
children.description: Email only: 2-layer logical reference (group/source) to the optional plain-text alternative body.
